beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Memes for 2030 explores ten ideas that could give technological change a human direction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its memes are portable cultural propositions, rather than jokes or predictions of guaranteed virality.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book connects each phrase with an unmet need, possible practices, and dangers of corruption.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Maintenance, community, freedom, and public responsibility become questions about what societies choose to admire.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers gain material for making ideas consequential, instead of merely making them visible.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book treats a memorable phrase as a beginning, rather than a completed cultural change.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Maintenance Is Heroism asks what happens when care and repair receive visible status.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A bridge inspection, a software patch, and sustained care become parts of one moral reversal.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The chapter also asks when preserving an institution merely protects something that should change.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Each candidate idea is therefore developed through practices and its own possible corruption.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Unavailability Is Freedom names the difference between useful connection and permanent obligation to respond.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book explores how that principle could alter expectations, products, and institutional rules.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its discussion of fame similarly connects attention with disclosure, repair, restraint, and succession.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These ideas are cultural proposals, not measured predictions about which slogan will succeed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their ethical value must remain distinct from their ability to spread.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the introduction on how private discomfort can acquire shared public language.
